content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of static imports in the `MinimalImportScanner` class, specifically when checking for the presence of static fields in the same class. The original implementation used a `HashSet` to store qualified name tokens, which did not maintain the order of elements. This led to situations where the last qualified name token was not correctly checked against the field and method names, resulting in incorrect static import statements being generated. The fix involved changing the data structure to a `LinkedList`, which preserves the order, and ensuring that the last token is checked properly to prevent unnecessary static imports within the same class.
